rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_basic AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    institutions_name,
    acronym,
    short_name,
    country_id,
    geocode_regions_3,
    website
  FROM institutions
),
project_members_by_institution AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    region_name,
    geocode_regions_3,
    country
  FROM project_members
),
denmark_id AS (
  SELECT unics_id
  FROM countries
  WHERE country_name = 'Denmark'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ib.unics_id,
  ib.institutions_name,
  ib.acronym,
  ib.short_name,
  ib.country_id,
  ib.geocode_regions_3,
  ib.website
FROM institutions_basic ib
WHERE
  -- direct region match on the institution record
  ib.geocode_regions_3 = 'Nordjylland'
  OR ib.geocode_regions_3 ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
  -- or any project member row for that institution is located in Nordjylland
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM project_members_by_institution pm
    WHERE pm.unics_id = ib.unics_id
      AND (
        pm.region_name = 'Nordjylland'
        OR pm.geocode_regions_3 ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
      )
  )
  -- fallback: include institutions in Denmark (only if region-level data unavailable)
  OR ib.country_id = (SELECT unics_id FROM denmark_id)
ORDER BY ib.institutions_name

rows.question: Find the name of principal investigators in projects that started in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.principal_investigator,
    p.start_year
  FROM projects p
),
people_core AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.full_name
  FROM people p
)
SELECT DISTINCT pe.full_name AS principal_investigator_name
FROM projects_core pr
JOIN people_core pe
  ON pr.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
WHERE pr.start_year = 2014

rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_end_date_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.end_date,
    p.acronym,
    p.title
  FROM projects p
),
project_topic_links AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id AS project,
    pt.topic AS topic
  FROM projects p
  JOIN project_topics pt ON pt.project = p.unics_id
),
topics_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    t.code,
    t.title
  FROM topics t
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  tc.code AS topic_code,
  tc.title AS topic_title
FROM projects_end_date_cohort p
JOIN project_topic_links pt ON pt.project = p.unics_id
JOIN topics_canonical tc ON tc.code = pt.topic
WHERE p.end_date BETWEEN DATE '2014-01-01' AND DATE '2014-12-31'
ORDER BY tc.code

rows.question: Show the name of members in projects costing less than the average project cost.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.total_cost
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.total_cost IS NOT NULL
),
project_members_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    pm.unics_id,
    pm.project,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.member_name, ''), NULL) AS member_name
  FROM project_members pm
  WHERE pm.unics_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT pm.member_name
FROM (
  SELECT unics_id, total_cost, AVG(total_cost) OVER () AS avg_total
  FROM projects_row_level
) p
JOIN project_members_row_level pm ON p.unics_id = pm.project
WHERE p.total_cost < p.avg_total
  AND pm.member_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pm.member_name

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_with_funding_scheme AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
    NULLIF(p.ec_fund_scheme, '')::text AS ec_fund_scheme
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
),
funding_scheme_projects_count AS (
  SELECT
    pwfs.ec_fund_scheme,
    COUNT(pwfs.project_unics_id) AS project_count
  FROM projects_with_funding_scheme pwfs
  GROUP BY pwfs.ec_fund_scheme
)
SELECT fs.code,
       fs.title
FROM funding_scheme_projects_count fspc
JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON fspc.ec_fund_scheme = fs.code
ORDER BY fspc.project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_with_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
),
projects_duration_calc AS (
  SELECT
    pwy.unics_id,
    pwy.acronym,
    pwy.title,
    pwy.start_year,
    pwy.end_year,
    (pwy.end_year - pwy.start_year) AS duration_years
  FROM projects_with_years pwy
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  duration_years
FROM projects_duration_calc
WHERE duration_years = (
  SELECT MAX(duration_years) FROM projects_duration_calc
)
ORDER BY duration_years DESC
